title: Prediction input contract
story: As an API client, I want invalid inputs to be rejected clearly so that I can fix my request.
acceptance_criteria: AC-101-1: Values at the bounds of every field are accepted. | AC-101-2: A value outside a bound, or of the wrong type, returns 422 and names the faulty fields, sorted. | AC-101-3: An empty body is valid: every field has a default. | AC-101-4: An invalid request returns 422 even when no model is loaded. | AC-101-5: The API accepts exactly the ranges that the training data validation accepts.

title: Prediction responses
story: As an API client, I want a predictable answer in every situation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-102-1: A valid request returns the fare rounded to the cent and the model version, computed from the 9 model features. | AC-102-2: Without a model the API returns 503 and never loads a model during the request. | AC-102-3: An error raised by the model returns 500 without exposing internal details. | AC-102-4: Logs name the faulty fields of a rejected request, never their values.

title: Readiness
story: As an operator, I want `/health` to tell whether the service can really predict.
acceptance_criteria: AC-103-1: Without a model, `/health` returns 503. | AC-103-2: With a model that cannot predict, `/health` returns 503. | AC-103-3: With a working model, `/health` returns 200 with the version and a smoke fare.

title: Serving the champion
story: As a data scientist, I want the API to serve the latest champion without a restart.
acceptance_criteria: AC-104-1: When no champion exists, nothing changes and the API keeps answering 503. | AC-104-2: A new champion version is loaded and its version is reported. | AC-104-3: The same version is not loaded twice.

title: Data preparation
story: As a data engineer, I want raw trips to become clean features.
acceptance_criteria: AC-105-1: Source columns are renamed and the output has the 9 features then the target, in order. | AC-105-2: A missing required column fails and names every missing column. | AC-105-3: `pickup_weekday` is 1 from Monday to Friday and 0 at the weekend. | AC-105-4: `total_fare` adds the optional components, counting absent ones as 0.

title: Data validation and quarantine
story: As a data engineer, I want bad rows set aside, never lost, and a broken source to stop the pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: AC-106-1: Rows outside the valid ranges are quarantined with a reason naming the column. | AC-106-2: Missing, infinite and non-numeric values are quarantined. | AC-106-3: More than 20% invalid rows fails the preparation; exactly 20% passes. | AC-106-4: Fewer than 100 valid rows fails the preparation; exactly 100 passes. | AC-106-5: The limits come from the configuration file, not from the code.

title: Ingestion
story: As a data engineer, I want ingestion to be safe to retry.
acceptance_criteria: AC-107-1: An invalid month or a limit under 100 fails before anything is downloaded. | AC-107-2: Ingesting the same source twice does not duplicate valid or quarantined rows. | AC-107-3: Quarantined rows are stored with their reason.

title: Training and promotion
story: As a data scientist, I want a new model to replace the champion only when it is better.
acceptance_criteria: AC-108-1: Candidate and champion are scored on the same validation data. | AC-108-2: The candidate is promoted only if there is no champion or if its error is strictly lower; a tie keeps the champion. | AC-108-3: Every candidate is registered as a new version, promoted or not, with its metrics, parameters and training sample. | AC-108-4: The champion alias moves only after the model and its artifacts are stored.

title: Fast enough API
story: As a product owner, I want the API to be fast enough for our users.
acceptance_criteria: AC-109-1: The API responds fast enough.

title: Retrain when data changes
story: As a product owner, I want the model to be retrained when the data changes a lot.
acceptance_criteria: AC-110-1: A significant data change triggers a retraining.

title: Better model quality
story: As a product owner, I want the predictions to be more accurate.
acceptance_criteria: AC-111-1: The model is more accurate than today.
